name: Jidoukan
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood children's after-school hall (Donguri Jidoukan): a notice about snack time changing, a first day working part-time there, a usage guide, a craft-event notice, a things-to-bring guide, a lesson learned about talking to children thoughtfully, teaching a new staff member the allergy-safe snack routine, an essay on why usage grew, an event calendar, a column on how the role of after-school childcare has changed, a notice of revised operating rules, a reflection on the meaning of time accumulated at a children's hall, and a one-year cooperation report with a local childcare support network. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
